messages:
Sam: Quick async standup — what I did: rolled route-policy v2 canary (path weights + header-based routing). Blockers: seeing a ~10% 502 spike in eu-west-1 during the canary window; gateway turning auth 401s into 502s. Today: rolling canary back to 0% in eu-west-1 and running an auth key sweep.

Anya: I see the 401 cluster in auth-service logs at 08:53 UTC. Starting a trace to check JWK KID mismatches and token rotation.

Mike: FYI I merged a small change to JWT middleware earlier (PR #889). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/889 Might be related if header names changed.

Riya: can someone paste a raw failing request (headers + minimal body)? I'll try to replay locally with the same token flow.

Sam: here's a minimal repro that failed for me:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>" \
  -H "X-Route: /v1/generate" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.internal/api
```
Response from auth-service: 401 -> gateway surfaces as 502 on canary instances.

Jordan: note that throttling defaults were tightened yesterday to 100 req/s. If the canary has a retry loop, it could amplify auth failures. Check `throttle.window_ms` and retry backoff config.

Anya: rolling canary to 0% for eu-west-1 now.

deploy-bot: canary rollout updated — route-policy-v2 eu-west-1 -> 0% (by Anya) CI #4578

Mike: holding other merges to canary until auth is stable. I'll re-check headers/claims in PR #889.

Riya: grabbed a failing log and replayed locally. Reproduced 401 when the token's KID doesn't match the server JWKs. Swapping in rotated keyset fixes it.

Sam: that matches my hypothesis. Filing ENGPLAT-2917 to add fallback JWK fetch with jitter/backoff and improved logging for KID mismatches.

Anya: spun up a quick dashboard: logs -> auth_service -> 401/5xx rates. Sharing link in #observability channel.

Jordan: I'll add a temp alert for >5% 401 across canary instances over 5m; opening alert PR now.

Mike: good plan. After the fallback is in, let's canary in small steps (5% -> 20% -> 50%) and monitor the auth metric and 502 rate.

Riya: no blockers from my side once keyset is updated. Will ping when patch is ready.

Sam: TL;DR plan: (1) rollback canary in eu-west-1 -> done, (2) confirm JWK rotation & add fetch fallback (ENGPLAT-2917), (3) patch -> controlled re-canary in increments. Will post updates here.

Sam: side-note: rate-limit docs need a short note on per-route burst behavior and `Retry-After`. If anyone has ~20m to pair up, LMK. Jordan offered earlier.
